notes.title: Upcoming game The Witch in The Woods
notes.content:
The Witch in The Woods is a light yuri visual novel with multiple endings set in a fantasy world. 

If you are interested, please check out our store page and add it to your wishlist: 

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2425680]https://store.steampowered.com/app/2425680[/url]

Story:

No one dares to go into the perilous Greywind Forest. According to legend, there are beings outside the norms and more dangerous than wild beasts. Once inside, there is no getting out. 

A wicked family of witches is rumored to reside in the depths of this woodland, using the blood of young girls as a source of material for black magic.

The witch family is allegedly no longer in Greywind Forest, but one of the witches has just made a comeback.

Nellie enters the Greywind Forest for her own reasons and encounters the stunning but dangerous witch there. What fate awaits her?

notes.title: In-Game Puzzle Hints and Character Sprites Update
notes.content:
After the game released, we received some really good feedback and we decided to make some changes to make the experience better.

We have implemented In-game hints to help solving puzzles. Now in a lot of puzzles, when you open the puzzle interface, you will see a lightbulb icon on the left. Click on that icon and you can get some insights on how to solve that puzzle.

We have also updated character sprites and some of the CGs. We changed the previous thick black lines to color lines and soften the character art in general, so they look better and blend with the background better.

We hope you enjoy the update. Thank you!

notes.title: Puzzle walkthrough is available now!
notes.content:
We have made a simple walkthrough that can help you if you are stuck on any of the puzzles or can't figure out how to reach some of the endings.

[url=https://dreamnyghtstudio.wixsite.com/thewishingstone/walk-through]Walkthrough here[/url]

notes.title: The Wishing Stone is released now! Walkthrough will be posted in about a week!
notes.content:
The Wishing Stone is released now. 
If you find bugs or run into problems, please send an email to dreamnyghtstudio@gmail.com and we will work on solving it. We will also post a simple walkthrough in about a week. It will include the solves to the puzzles and conditions to reach some of the endings.

Thank you so much! Hope you enjoy the game!

notes.title: The Wishing Stone will be released on Dec. 9th!
notes.content:
We have decided on the release date! The Wishing Stone will be released on Dec. 9th, 2021. It's just a month away!

Please mark the date and Wishlist if you haven't done so yet! We will have a release discount in the first week. 

We have also updated the store page with more screenshots and details over the past couple of months. Check it out! 

Thank you so much for your patience and support! we hope to see you soon!

notes.title: Game Development Progress and Release Update
notes.content:
Hello Everyone,

Thank you so much for your interest in The Wishing Stone!

After working hard on it, the game development is at about 90% mark and we are working hard to finish the last 10%. Originally we wanted to release the game in September but judging from the current progress and considering testing, debugging, editing and polishing afterwards, most likely there will be a delay in release time and we'll release in Q4 instead. 

We are really sorry about the delay. We don't want to rush release a game that's not ready. Once we have an actual release date, we will give another update. 

Thank you again for your patience and for your interest in our game! 

Dream Nyght Studio
